news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.57 (vs ₹0.48 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.57 (up from ₹0.48 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹23.4b (down 46% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹690.1m (up ₹1.20b from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.9% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 35% per year and the company’s share price has also fallen by 35% per year.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: There is 1 new director who has joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 1 new director. 9 experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Independent Director Venky Mysore was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
